title.narrative: Community Center in Rural Damascus (Arbin - Al Qutayfah)

description.narrative: ltpgtEPDC has a community center in Arbin since 2018, the center has been providing Al Qutayfah diverse services among the years: GBV and still working and funded by two partners (NCA – ZOA) providing many services like case management and awareness sessions and medical referrals and others, all services are directed to the survivors from the Gender-Based Violence - PHC worked for 5 years with different services and specialties that passed on it, all kinds of services ensured that the patients in Arbin that are far from the city and are not able to obtain the good medical service now have this ability with as much full medical service as possible. EPDC’s PHC was closed in 2023 due to the end of the funded project, the center is full equipped with all needed devices (Eco Devices – ECG – X-Ray – other essential small devices like oximeter, blood pressure gauge and other vital signs devices). EPDC was serving more than 5,000 patients annually with more than one visit and follow up giving them the full medical service starting by the full diagnosis and ending by the treatment with provision the medicines for free.ltbrgtThe PHC in Arbin will include some essential medical specialties (Cardiology, pediatric, Gynecology, internal medicine) provide the following services:ltbrgtSubmission of 800 medical consultations for free, medical prescription support to 400 patients, lab test services for 120 patients, radiology services as per the need.ltbrgtAlso, Health awareness session training will be conducted for 30 people per month, with a program that is designed after making a community study to determine the most common diseases by the health awareness sessions provider, each one of the attendees will receive a first aid kit by the end of the course as a gift and to use it in the house, for sure one of the most important topic is about the first aid, and the content of the kit is designed to suit the need of each house (you can find it in the BOQ).ltbrgtAll the above service will be provided to the most vulnerable population by a pre-designed selection criteria with coordination with MEAL department at EPDC.ltbrgtchild protection project will be implemented in Rural Damascus (Al Qutayfah) the project will encompasses a comprehensive set of activities aimed at safeguarding children and supporting their families. The project includes the provision of case management services specifically focused on child protection issues, ensuring that individual needs are assessed and addressed. It also offers structured and sustained group activities that provide psychosocial support (PSS) to children, available both in centers and through mobile team. Additionally, the project implements parenting programs that educate and empower parents on effective parenting practices and child protection.ltbrgtCommunity engagement is a key component, with awareness-raising sessions, community events, and activity days designed to educate the broader community about child protection issues. This aspect of the project seeks to promote community involvement and awareness, helping to create a safer environment for all children.ltbrgtFinally, the project includes training on the foundations of child protection, covering essential knowledge and minimum standards. This training is aimed at individuals involved in child protection services, equipping them with the necessary skills to effectively protect children and uphold their rights. Overall, the project takes a holistic approach to child protection, addressing immediate needs, providing fostering a protective community environment.ltbrgtlt/pgt
